text:
Liam K: Heads-up — another webinar surge created ~50 leads stuck in pending-enrich. Round-robin kept skipping them because 'sticky_owner' lock prevents reassign for 2h. Business SLA is 30m, we missed it.
Soraya N: Ugh. The sticky window was intended for churn protection but it's too aggressive for high-volume marketing events. For webinar tag we should reduce sticky to 3m or allow a temporary failover owner.
Priya S: Agree. Prefer temporary failover (temp-assign) with a short TTL so sales doesn't get noisy churn. Mark temp assigns with header X-Claim-Temp=true so CS knows not to action.
Liam K: Proposal: for leads with tag:webinar and source in [zoom, hopin], if enrich pending > 90s AND sticky_owner_age > 3m then temp_assign to overflow-sdr with TTL=20m. Allow one safe swap when enrichment arrives.
Soraya N: Add safety: exclude enterprise accounts (company_tier=enterprise) and cap swaps at 1. Also track metrics temp_assigns, swap_count, duplicate_claims.
Priya S: Can we scope as a feature-flag and canary? ff.temp_assign.webinar=true. Also add alert: if duplicate_claims > 3 in 1h -> page #oncall.
Liam K: Pseudocode I'm planning to PR:```javascript
// only for webinar, non-enterprise
if (lead.tags.includes('webinar') && !lead.enterprise && now - enrich.requested_at > 90000) {
  if (sticky.age > 180000 && !lead.flags.temp_assigned) {
    lead.flags.temp_assigned = true
    enqueueAssign(lead, 'overflow-sdr', {ttl_ms: 1200000, header: 'X-Claim-Temp:true'})
  }
}
// on enrich callback
if (enrich.arrived && lead.current_owner != enrich.owner && lead.swap_count < 1) {
  replaceOwner(lead, enrich.owner)
  lead.swap_count += 1
}
```
Soraya N: Good. I'll add a quick dashboard: temp_assigns, swap_rate, time_to_first_claim_by_tag. Priya, can you notify Sales with a 1-paragraph note about temp-assign semantics?
Priya S: Yes. I'll post in #sales and add a short FAQ doc.
Liam K: I'll open PR and include rollback instructions. Plan: dev->canary(5%)->monitor 30m->prod.

Priya S: Sales note posted: "Leads marked X-Claim-Temp:true are temporary owners; wait for enriched owner before outreach if possible."
Liam K: Great. Keep canary for 4h then evaluate for wider rollout. Filing follow-up JIRA for permanent sticky_owner logic: https://jira.redwood/browse/MKT-8210
Priya S: Thanks everyone. This should keep the funnel healthy during big promos. :thumbsup:
